goal: Deliver Phase 1 of the Pi Observable Assurance Orchestration Roadmap: the parent Agent can request one bounded assurance advance, QA and native Review run without blocking Pi input, required Immune-Brain status remains visibly honest throughout each background job, fresh QA pass starts one Review, and material terminal states wake the parent Agent, while native Review remains advisory and every existing literal-user authority boundary stays unchanged.

acceptance.assertion: The closed imm_kernel_canary tool exposes only host-derived advance_assurance and cancel_assurance orchestration in addition to its existing ordinary actions; advance returns a structured started, blocked, awaiting_user, or completed result without waiting for background terminal settlement, duplicate advance reuses the active job, and neither operation accepts or mints privileged authority payloads.

Every deterministic QA and native Review job publishes starting before expensive preparation, keeps a one-second Footer and Immune-Brain Widget projection with stage, elapsed time, deadline, cancellation state, and honest telemetry availability, and publishes a bounded terminal result independently of the optional native subagent widget.

A fresh deterministic QA pass starts exactly one Pi native background Review, while QA rework does not; QA rework and every Review terminal state emit exactly one task, operation, record, Intent, and diff-correlated Pi follow-up that triggers the parent Agent without a user continue message, and stale or replayed follow-ups cannot advance Kernel state.

Current Skill and dispatch contracts require a visible dispatch acknowledgement, a persistent status surface, background execution for unknown-duration planning, exploration, and review children, no result polling, no nested delegation, one Kernel Review child per immutable snapshot, and no more than two independently triggered advisory or discovery children.

Cancellation, timeout, session shutdown, stale snapshot, duplicate advance, late or duplicate native terminal events, and follow-up replay remain fail closed with no duplicate jobs or unauthorized TaskRecord writes; Review output remains advisory, record-review-verdict remains literal-user confirmed, every other privileged operation remains absent from Agent-callable schemas, and the full Pi package regression passes.
